item.title: AircraftPrices.com Content & Design Revamp
item.description:
750-1500 USD | I’m ready to reposition AircraftPrices.com so visitors immediately see us as the very first step in any aircraft acquisition, then feel a clear, confident path toward a certified valuation and our AEROMAX buyer-protection service.
Here’s what I need: the copy on the home page, the service pages, and the pricing sections must be rewritten so the $400 piston valuation, the $600 turbine valuation, and the “see website for USPAP desktop appraisal” message stand out and naturally lead prospects to the next stage of the funnel. Tone should feel authoritative yet approachable, speaking to serious buyers who understand the value of an independent report.
While the words are being refined, the visual skin of the site must also come up to modern standards. I want a fresh, contemporary look, seamless mobile responsiveness, and an intuitive flow that makes it obvious where to click next—no hunting, no clutter. Think clean typography, faster load times, and UI/UX touches that make forms, comparison charts, and contact calls to action effortless on both phone and desktop. The existing platform can stay in place; front-end redesign in WordPress or a comparable framework is fine as long as load speed and security best practices are met.
Deliverables: • Revised copy for home, services, and pricing sections that highlights valuations and guides users toward AEROMAX. • A fully responsive visual redesign implemented on the live site with all current pages intact. • UI/UX improvements validated on major browsers and current iOS/Android devices. • Handover of source files and any style guides so my team can keep everything consistent after launch.
Once the refreshed site is live I’ll test the new funnel with paid traffic; if engagement improves we can discuss phase two—adding interactive tools or client dashboards. For now, I just need the words and the look to match the premium nature of our reports.

item.title: SEO Optimization & Hosting for Pool Service Site
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m looking for an experienced web professional to host and optimize my pool service company’s website for maximum visibility on Google and other major search engines.
My business is AAAquatic Pool Services, based in Bradenton, Florida. We specialize in pool cleaning, repairs, leak detection, and green-to-clean services. I need someone who can not only provide reliable hosting but also make sure my website shows up when homeowners search for pool services in my area.
Responsibilities:
Provide secure, reliable website hosting (preferably with cPanel or similar)
Migrate or set up my existing website on your hosting platform
Perform a complete SEO audit and on-page optimization (titles, tags, keywords, image alt text, etc.)
Improve page loading speed and mobile performance
Set up and link Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and Google Business Profile
Optimize for local SEO (Bradenton, Sarasota, and surrounding areas)
Research and integrate target keywords like:
pool cleaning Bradenton
pool service near me
pool repair & leak detection
green-to-clean pool service
Optional: provide ongoing maintenance and SEO tracking reports
Requirements:
Proven experience with SEO and website hosting
Skilled with WordPress or similar CMS
Familiarity with local business SEO strategies
Ability to show past results and communicate clearly
Must be reliable and responsive
Deliverables:
Fully hosted, optimized, and mobile-friendly website SEO improvements reflected in Google rankings and site speed Local search visibility improvements (Google Maps, business listings, etc.)
When Applying, Please Include:
Hosting platform or server setup you recommend At least 2–3 examples of websites you’ve optimized A brief overview of your SEO strategy for a local service business

item.title: Corporate Website UX/UI Redesign
item.description:
250-750 USD | We are looking for an experienced UX/UI designer or design agency to redesign the UX/UI of our corporate website.
The project will focus on improving the website’s navigation, usability, clarity, visual experience, and homepage experience, with the final designs delivered in Figma.
Scope of Work
UX Audit & Discovery UX audit of the website navigation, footer, and homepage Stakeholder discussions/workshops to understand requirements and goals Identify key pain points and opportunities Review navigation and content gaps Website Navigation & Information Architecture Redesign the desktop website navigation Define the navigation structure and approach Review information architecture, content hierarchy, and user flows Improve overall usability and clarity Homepage Redesign Develop homepage layout concepts Explore two distinct visual directions Define interaction and animation concepts, including hover and scroll interactions Develop the selected homepage direction Create the final responsive/mobile adaptation Footer Redesign Redesign the website footer for desktop and mobile Provide footer design concepts focused on usability and clarity UI Design & Prototyping High-fidelity Figma designs Responsive design Component and layout consistency Interaction/prototype design Final design refinements based on feedback

item.title: Sell Virtual Fitting Room Solution
item.description:
750-1500 GBP | I need a results-driven closer who can place Viewra—our web-based virtual changing room—into the right hands and earn a generous commission on every deal secured.
What you’ll be offering Viewra drops straight into any e-commerce fashion site, retail brand website or even a marketplace platform and lets shoppers try garments on their own photos before they buy. It works seamlessly on both desktop and mobile, so you can pitch it as a friction-free upgrade that lifts conversion and slashes returns. The current release focuses on ultra-fast user photo uploads with realistic draping; 3D rendering and sizing AI are on the roadmap, so early adopters get a future-proof tool.
Your mission • Identify qualified merchants and decision-makers • Demo Viewra, handle objections, and negotiate terms • Close the contract—my team takes care of integration and support
Commission structure This is a high-ticket SaaS licence with an attractive earning potential. You’ll receive a £50 monthly retainer for one year (£600 total) plus a 15-20% commission per sale, with commissions starting at £600 minimum per deal closed. If you already have a network in fashion tech, you’ll find the margins very rewarding.
What to include in your bid • Your background selling B2B software, especially to fashion or retail • Average deal size or conversion stats you’ve achieved • How many qualified leads you can approach in the first 30 days
Once your first client goes live, the commission is released immediately; subsequent renewals pay out as well. I handle demos, onboarding guides and all technical questions you can’t answer—your focus stays on opening doors and closing deals. Let’s talk targets and kick off the first round of pitches.

item.title: Design Three Premium Landing Pages
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need three distinct yet visually cohesive landing pages built with a clean, high-end aesthetic:
1. Yanama Rituals – a one-product preorder page for Cacao Balance. It must highlight benefits, ingredients, preparation steps, an FAQ, and capture email addresses while keeping the flow simple and conversion-focused.
2. RSL Creative Co – an agency-style page that instantly feels established and strategic. It should cover strong positioning, core services, a concise “how we work” section, and end with a clear inquiry CTA.
3. RAM SAI – an elegant coming-soon page for an Indian clothing and jewelry brand that teases the collection and invites visitors to join an email waitlist.
All three pages should share a minimal, elevated design language but still respect each brand’s personality. I’ll supply logos, photography, and any copy I already have; if gaps appear, I’m open to quick refinements from you for consistency.
Please let me know: • links to landing pages you’ve designed in a similar premium style • the platform or stack you recommend (Webflow, Framer, custom HTML/CSS, etc.) and why it keeps the build simple and cost-effective • your estimated timeline from kickoff to launch, broken down per page • an all-inclusive quote with any optional add-ons clearly noted
I value crisp typography, generous white space, and intuitive mobile responsiveness. If this aligns with your skill set, I’d love to review your portfolio and move forward.

item.title: Framer Portfolio Website Rebuild
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I recently bought a Framer template and now I want to turn it into a clean, fully-functional portfolio that showcases my professional work. The finished site needs four polished sections — About Me, Projects, Testimonials and Contact Me —each matching the visual language of the template while highlighting my experience and results.
My current website is www.visioneditz.com. I've upgraded to Framer to make it look more professional and a better design. This should give you an idea of my current design.
Here is what I need you to do:
• Customise the template’s colours, fonts and layout so it feels uniquely mine without breaking Framer best practices • Build responsive versions of the About Me, Projects, Testimonials and Contact Me pages, ensuring they look perfect on desktop, tablet and mobile • Set up a filterable Projects gallery that I can expand later inside Framer’s CMS • Integrate a working contact form that delivers messages straight to my email • Optimise load speed, basic on-page SEO and smooth scroll/transition effects already provided in the template
Acceptance criteria – All four sections render correctly across modern browsers and major screen sizes – Copy, images and links can be edited directly in Framer’s editor without code changes – Contact form sends a confirmation to visitors and to my inbox – Google PageSpeed score of 90+ on desktop and 80+ on mobile for the homepage
I’ll supply all copy, images and brand guidelines once we start. Please share a couple of Framer sites you’ve launched so I can get a feel for your style, and let me know how soon you can deliver a first draft.
The template name on Framer is called "Fade".

item.title: Elegant Photography Portfolio Website
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I need a small, visually refined site that presents my best photographs in a classic, elegant way. The project centres on creating a clean portfolio with intuitive navigation, fullscreen image galleries, and tasteful typography that lets the work speak for itself.
Key pages will include: a landing page with an impactful hero image, a gallery section organised by series, an about page, and a simple contact form. Smooth transitions, responsive layout and fast-loading image optimisation are essential so the site feels polished on desktop, tablet and mobile alike.
Feel free to suggest the framework or CMS you believe will deliver the most stable, future-proof result—WordPress, Webflow, or a lightweight custom build are all on the table as long as the final product is easy for me to update with new photos. Once the design is approved, I’ll supply high-resolution images and copy. Please package the finished files, clearly commented code or CMS login, and a concise hand-off guide so I can maintain the gallery myself.

item.title: Detailed Travel Itinerary Compilation
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’ve gathered flights, hotels, activities, and even a few restaurant confirmations for an upcoming trip and need everything brought together into one polished document. You’ll receive the booking emails and screenshots; your task is to pull out the key information and organise it day-by-day.
Each entry should show the date, time, booking reference, and a contact phone or email so I can reach the airline, hotel, tour operator, or restaurant in a hurry. A clean, easy-to-scan layout in a Word or PDF file is perfect; if you have a template you love, feel free to use it, otherwise build one that looks professional and printable.
Deliverables: • A single itinerary document covering: – Flight information – Hotel reservations – Activity bookings – Restaurant reservations • Logical daily flow (chronological, with clear headings) • Embedded or linked confirmation numbers and contact details for every item
Once the draft is ready, I’ll review and send any tweaks; a quick turnaround on revisions would be appreciated so I can share the final file with travelling companions.

item.title: WooCommerce Photo Review Upgrade
item.description:
3000-5000 USD | I want to overhaul the default WooCommerce review flow so it actually converts: customers must be able to attach a photo, see a “Verified purchase” badge, and leave feedback that is immediately useful to shoppers and to Google.
Core work • Replace the plain-text comment box with an upload-enabled form that resizes images on the fly, accepts only safe formats (jpg, png, gif), and stores them securely. • Tie reviews to order IDs so the “Verified purchase” badge shows automatically and, where a product has variations, assign the review to the correct colour/size. • Build a moderation queue that filters obvious spam without swallowing real reviews; I will supply policy guidelines, you handle the logic and flagging rules. • Trigger review-request emails only after tracking shows the parcel has been delivered. • Add structured data so aggregate ratings and photo thumbnails surface correctly in Google rich results, following the current review markup spec.
Technical context The shop runs on the latest WooCommerce and hooks straight into the native WordPress comment system. I need someone comfortable with those hooks, secure file-handling functions, image processing libraries (GD or Imagick), and schema.org/Google guidelines.
Acceptance A staging site will be provided. Once I can submit a review with a photo, see it moderated, see badges and variation links display properly on the product page, receive the timed email, and validate structured data in Google’s Rich Results Test, the job is done.

item.title: Real Estate & Mortgage Duo
item.description:
250-750 USD | My wife and I are looking to create a professional, modern website that brings our real estate and lending businesses together under one cohesive brand.
I am a real estate agent specializing in residential properties, farm and ranch, land, and commercial real estate. My wife is a licensed mortgage loan originator who handles residential mortgages, construction loans, and commercial financing.
We want the website to introduce us as a husband-and-wife team and give clients one place to learn about who we are and the different ways we can help. From there, visitors should be able to easily navigate to the appropriate side of the business whether they are looking to buy or sell real estate, purchase land or a ranch, explore a commercial opportunity, or need financing.
The overall design should feel high-end, clean, modern, and professional rather than like a traditional Realtor or mortgage website. The real estate side will also link to a separate real estate website where clients can search properties, view listings, and learn more about our real estate services.
Ultimately, we want the main website to serve as the central hub for our brand and clearly communicate that we can help clients with both real estate and financing across residential, land, construction, and commercial opportunities.

item.title: Vape E-commerce & EPOS Integration
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I’m ready to launch a full-featured online vape store and I need someone who can connect it seamlessly to my existing EPOS system so stock levels stay in sync in real time. There are roughly 700 SKUs to import, each with images, variants and the usual compliance information.
Platform is flexible—Shopify or WooCommerce are both fine with me—so long as the final build is fast, secure and easy to maintain. Alongside the core catalogue and checkout, I want customer-facing extras such as product reviews and ratings, an intuitive search with filters for flavour, nicotine strength, device type, etc., plus a simple loyalty programme that rewards repeat purchases.
For the look and feel I’ll share a few reference sites; I’m happy to work from a quality theme or light custom design so you’re not starting from a blank canvas.
Deliverables • Complete storefront configured on Shopify or WooCommerce • EPOS integration with bi-directional, live inventory sync • Bulk import of ~700 products (titles, descriptions, images, tags) • Built-in reviews, advanced filtering, and loyalty programme activated and tested • Mobile-optimised design based on my reference examples • Handover session with documentation on managing stock and promotions
Once everything is live, I expect to be able to scan an item in-store, see the stock adjust online instantly, and offer customers a smooth buying experience from discovery to checkout. If you’ve tackled similar vape or high-SKU projects before and know your way around EPOS connectors, I’d love to hear how you’d approach this build and an estimated timeline for each milestone.

item.title: Zoho CRM Layout & Sign Conversion
item.description:
250-750 USD | I run a young waste-management startup and I’m streamlining our customer journey inside Zoho. What I need right now is:
• Two clean, intuitive layouts in Zoho CRM – Customer Profile: all contact, site and service details at a glance – Sales Pipeline: clear stage-to-stage view that feeds our forecasts
• Document conversion templates in Zoho Sign – Contracts, agreements and our standard proposals must merge automatically with CRM data, route for e-signature, then file back to the correct record
• Core CRM tweaks – Lead Management: custom fields, views and simple automation so new leads drop into the right pipeline stage – Reporting & Analytics: dashboards that show lead source performance, deal velocity and revenue projections pulled straight from the new layouts
Acceptance is straightforward: every layout loads without errors on web and mobile, each merged document reaches signers with the right data, and the new reports refresh in real time.
If you’re comfortable working inside the Zoho ecosystem and can turn these requirements into a working setup, let’s get started.

item.title: Website Optimisation for Digital Art Sales
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I run an online store that offers downloadable abstract art prints. The site is live, theproducts are uploaded, yet the buying journey still feels unfinished and traffic remains modest. I need a hand turning the current setup into a polished, sales-ready experience.
First, every print must be fully commerce-enabled. That means con firming product variants, pricing tiers and automatic delivery links, then wiring each item to a reliable checkout and shipping solution so a customer can buy, download or request physical fulfilment without friction.
Next comes presentation. I want visitors to explore the collection through interactive galleries, zoom into crisp high-resolution images and even preview pieces inside virtual art rooms. You are free to propose the best-fit plugins or custom code, but the end result should feel immersive and load quickly on desktop and mobile alike.
Purchasing should be flexible. Customers must be able to complete the order directly on my site while simultaneously giving me the option to list the same SKUs on an external marketplace. A single source of truth for inventory and order tracking is important, so any integration you implement (API, feed, or middleware) needs to keep everything in sync.
Visibility is the last piece. My goal is higher rankings and more qualified traffic, so the focus is on keyword optimisation and fresh, engaging content around each artwork and artistic theme. Well-structured meta tags, schema, alt text and a concise content plan will be key; backlink outreach is not required right now.
Deliverables • Fully configured product catalogue with seamless checkout and shipping • Interactive gallery, high-resolution zoom and virtual room preview deployed site-wide • Dual sales channel integration (website + chosen marketplace) with synced stock/status • On-page SEO overhaul: keyword mapping, titles, meta, alt text, schema plus a short content calendar • Brief hand-off guide so I can maintain listings and publish new prints in the same workflow
If you have recent experience in e-commerce UX, art-focused presentation tools and practical SEO, I’d love to see how you would approach this upgrade.

item.title: Comprehensive Client Portal Build
item.description:
1500-3000 USD | We are a marketing and communications company seeking an experienced developer or small team to build a branded client and staff platform.
Our current service runs through account managers who handle website updates and support requests. The portal will let clients manage permitted website content, request assistance, collaborate on projects, approve work, access reports and manage social content.
It must also serve clients hiring us for website builds, surveys, marketing campaigns or consulting, without requiring a connected website or CRM account.
SOW AND EXISTING WORK
The detailed SOW and downloaded GitHub ZIP are available here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10tNkYhjd0IWnRud6oHX0ZTCOI9NusLi_?usp=sharing
The existing work is unfinished and requires validation. Reuse is optional. Explain what you would retain, refactor or rebuild, including authentication, permissions, data, storage and workflows.
Preferred stack: Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL/Supabase. A separate backend framework is not mandatory; explain any proposed changes. Visual references and workflow requirements are available. Identify missing screens and include agreed UI completion in your quote.
Please demonstrate experience with secure portals, WordPress/Elementor integrations, approval workflows and APIs.
REQUIRED RELEASE
WordPress Website Editing
Connect our Cloudways-hosted WordPress sites to the portal. Our stack includes Elementor Pro and ACF; other plugins and content patterns vary by site.
Clients must edit permitted text, images, links, documents, posts and approved page sections through a controlled portal interface. Include new pages from approved templates, drafts, previews, approval requests, publishing results and version recovery. Clients can also ask staff to make changes.
Approval and publishing rights are separate. Authorized users can publish directly where enabled; other editors submit for approval. Protect layouts and global settings. Detect direct WordPress changes, prevent silent overwrites and publish the exact approved version when approval is required. Include necessary cache handling and verification of published changes.
We will select a representative site and arrange authorized staging access. The detailed inventory is not complete. Validate supported templates, widgets, ACF fields, content types and editing actions. Identify limitations and preserve existing site functionality.
The early demonstration must cover an Elementor page, a standard post and a new page from an approved template, including editing, preview, approval, publishing, conflict detection and recovery. Access to unrestricted WordPress administration does not satisfy this requirement.
Client Portal
Provide a branded home screen showing the account manager, active services, projects, deadlines, requests and outstanding approvals.
Clients can communicate with staff, submit requests, upload assets, review deliverables, download reports and track progress. Show only their authorized services and actions.
Core project and collaboration features must work without a connected website, Google account or GoHighLevel account.
Staff and Contractor Workspace
Manage clients, projects, milestones, tasks, tickets, recurring work, assignments, files and discussions. Staff can assign work to themselves, authorized colleagues or contractors and complete it themselves.
Include work queues, overdue items, workload, onboarding progress, pending approvals, failed notifications and connection status.
Contractors see only explicitly assigned work, necessary files and designated discussions. Assignment must not expose the entire client or project. Internal staff notes and administration remain private.
Onboarding, Intake and Offboarding
Include editable service-specific intake forms, asset collection, reusable project templates, recurring checklists, invitations, first-login guidance and reminders.
Clients can save and resume forms. Staff can request corrections and track completion. Include service changes, work transfer, permitted exports and access removal.
For connected GoHighLevel accounts, include opportunity-won onboarding with duplicate protection for clients, projects and invitations.
Files, Reports and Approvals
Staff can organize, update and share PDFs and supporting files against the correct client and project. Clients access shared reports; internal files remain private.
Research reports will be prepared externally and uploaded manually. Direct Esri and Leadinfo integrations are not required.
Approvals apply to a specific version. Include comments, requested changes, decision history, due dates, reminders and authorized reassignment. Revisions requiring approval return for review. Overdue approvals must never approve themselves automatically.
Routine support tickets should not require unnecessary client sign-off. Include a searchable client help area maintained by staff.
Social Management, Reporting and GoHighLevel
Clients and staff can create, review, approve and schedule content, with a calendar and publication results. Include supported analytics, downloadable reports and agreed reputation actions such as viewing and replying to reviews.
We already pay for GoHighLevel's full SaaS/white-label service and use its CRM, pipeline, automations and phone/messaging setup. Assess those existing capabilities first. Twilio operates through GoHighLevel; preserve existing numbers, routing and automations.
Facebook, LinkedIn and Google Business Profile are the initial channels to assess. Connected profiles, API permissions, formats, metrics and supported actions still need verification. Identify capabilities that are tested, unverified or blocked, plus any additional applications, provider approvals, subscriptions or usage charges.
Track publication separately for each destination, handle partial failures and prevent duplicate posts during retries. Review requests should use the approved existing GoHighLevel workflow without duplicate sending.
Social management/reporting and agreed GoHighLevel onboarding are required. The customer inbox is a separate option below.
Permissions, Branding and Security
Support Agency Admin, Staff, Contractor, Client Admin, Client Member and Client Viewer roles, with separate viewing, editing, approval and publishing rights.
Enforce agency, client, project and assignment boundaries through database RLS and server authorization across APIs, files, search, exports, notifications and background jobs.
Include privileged-user MFA, private file access and audit history. Recheck authorization when queued actions execute. Removing an assignment must revoke access granted by it, including further access through previously shared portal links.
Only one agency will be live initially. Support separate agencies in the architecture and use a second staging agency for isolation and revocation tests. Commercial reseller rollout and reseller-specific domains are outside this release.
Keep agency branding separate from client identity. Include branded invitations, welcome/recovery emails and responsive client/staff screens.
Website and Launch Records
Provide a staff register for websites, domains, hosting, technical contacts, connection status and renewal responsibility.
Include staging review, client launch approval, launch checklists and verification records. Domain, hosting, infrastructure and data ownership remain under our control.
SEPARATELY PRICED OPTIONS
Google/Facebook sign-in for convenience. Email/password login, invitations and recovery are required. Optional sign-in must not bypass permissions or MFA.
Selection and sharing of existing Google Drive documents.
Viewing and replying to customer SMS/email conversations inside the portal through GoHighLevel.
Cloudways/Cloudflare status synchronization or authorized infrastructure controls beyond cache handling needed for publishing.
DELIVERY EXPECTATIONS
Include technical planning, code assessment and compatibility validation within the project. We are not purchasing a separate assessment.
Develop and deploy in accounts we control, committing source code to our repository throughout. Your team handles technical setup; we provide business decisions, authorized access and owner consent.
Include testing, daily off-site backups with at least 30-day retention, restore verification, documentation, staff training, handover and 90 days of post-launch defect fixes. Quote ongoing maintenance separately.
Launch website/profile counts are not finalized. State how many client accounts, websites and social profiles your fixed price includes and the costs for additional connections or new compatibility patterns.
There is no confirmed hard launch date. Propose a realistic schedule for the complete required release, including demonstrations, testing, training and deployment.
YOUR PROPOSAL MUST INCLUDE
Relevant working examples and your specific role.
Your approach to Elementor editing, permissions, approvals and recovery.
What you would reuse, refactor or rebuild.
A fixed total for the complete required scope, milestone deliverables and acceptance criteria.
Separately priced options.
Schedule, dependencies, compatibility limits and exclusions.
Recurring costs, distinguishing existing subscriptions from new expenses.
Who performs development, design, testing and support.
Whether your posted bid is the full-scope price or a preliminary amount.
The SOW defines requirements and acceptance checks. Flag conflicts, assumptions and exclusions before agreement. Include contingency in the fixed price and schedule; changes require written agreement.

- Easy content management - A robust booking system - Section for customer reviews
The design should be fun and colorful, reflecting the vibrant spirit of Boston.

item.title: Corporate Client Portal Website Build
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I’m building a fresh online presence that feels unmistakably corporate and professional while keeping client engagement front-and-centre.
Here’s the experience I’m after: visitors arrive on a polished landing page, learn what we do, then move into a secure portal that’s tailored to each of them. Inside that portal every client must be able to upload documents, check their own real-time sales totals and commissions, and open a message thread with our support team.
Alongside the portal I need a simple resources page—just clean hyperlinks pointing to a library of PDF files.
On the back end I’ll log into an admin dashboard that rolls up all management information: total sales by client, commissions by client, and overall performance statistics, with the option to export the data or view quick visual summaries.
Tech stack is flexible: WordPress with the right plugins, a Laravel or Django build, or a React/Node solution—whatever you’re most comfortable securing, scaling and handing over in a maintainable state. The finished site must be fully responsive, GDPR-compliant and easy for me to update without touching code.
Deliverables • Responsive landing page, resources page and secure client portal • Document upload, personal statistics display, and in-portal messaging functionality • Admin dashboard for MI: sales per client, commission per client, export options • Source code, deployment files and a brief hand-over guide
If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s talk through the timeline and milestones.

item.title: Bilingual WordPress Elementor Build
item.description:
350-400 USD | I already have every page laid out in Figma with final copy in both German and English; all typography, colours and spacing decisions are locked. What I need now is a developer who can translate those static designs into a live WordPress site built with Elementor, keep the build pixel-accurate, and make sure it looks just as good on phones and tablets as it does on a desktop monitor.
Scope of work • Spin up a clean WordPress install, add Elementor and configure WPML so users can switch seamlessly between German and English. • Recreate the exact page structure provided (logistics services, Munich-based business services, legal pages, blog, etc.). No creative changes—implementation only. • Add a basic contact form (Elementor Forms or similar) and wire it to the company email address. • Install and configure Yoast for on-page optimisation, meta tags, XML sitemap and basic schema. • Optimise images, enable caching and minification, and fine-tune Core Web Vitals so the finished site loads fast. • Check everything thoroughly: responsive breakpoints, navigation, language switcher, form deliverability, 404s, redirects and final QA before launch.
Deliverable A fully responsive, bilingual website published on the provided hosting account, ready for public release, delivered within 30 days.
Additional page designs and full English/German content will be provided to the selected freelancer.

item.title: Complete & Upgrade MERN Stack Website/App
item.description:
750-1500 EUR | We are looking for an experienced full-stack MERN developer with OpenAI, agentic development, React Native and UI design experience. Our website is approximately 97% complete.
